page.overview:
What is Kurpannga?

Kurpannga (also known as The Devil-dingo) is a fictional entity created by Sandy Petersen for the Call of Cthulhu supplement H. P. Lovecraft's Dreamlands, depicted as being a giant hairless dingo-like fiend living in the Dreamlands (or the Dreamtime of Aboriginal myth).
